t: What Tile Setting Is All About
title: What Tile Setting Is All About
description: Tile setters prepare surfaces and install ceramic, porcelain, stone, and glass tile on floors, walls, showers, and backsplashes. They handle layout, cutting, waterproofing, setting, and grouting. Residential remodelers, custom home builders, commercial tile contractors, and restoration specialists. Kitchens and bathrooms are the core residential markets. This record lays the foundation: the core purpose, the people it serves, and where it fits in everyday life.
